purpose: Prevent compressed sparse attention from conflating high-resolution compression, selector quality, sparse execution, and dense coarse coverage.

evidence_basis.supported: CSA selects less-compressed entries for precise access while HCA supplies a separate dense coarse view
evidence_basis.not_transferred: compression 4, top-k 512/1024, FP4 indexer, quality, and system ratios

evidence_basis.supported: coarse scan, selected contiguous fine blocks, and raw local context should be separately measurable; hardware-aware block grouping matters
evidence_basis.not_transferred: NSA block sizes, gates, sparsity, and kernel speedups

evidence_basis.supported: a learned indexer can be distilled against dense attention before sparse joint continuation
evidence_basis.not_transferred: top-2048, detached indexer recipe, trillion-token adaptation, and deployed parity

evidence_basis.supported: block routing is simpler and more contiguous than token routing, but execution modes and trailing-token loss must be disclosed
evidence_basis.not_transferred: mean-key sufficiency, block 512/top-3, or prefill-only quality as sparse-decode evidence

ordered_prerequisites: select and qualify the dense coarse HCA compressor and rate
qualify genuine long-dependency data and the existing evaluation gates
freeze dense teacher, selector targets, budgets, execution modes, and analysis before sparse outputs

factorization.coarse_global: selected HCA branch attends densely to aggressive summaries and is held fixed
factorization.precise_sparse: CSA attends to selected less-compressed historical units and is the only intervention
factorization.local: KDA remains fixed; a raw SWA branch is a later separate family
factorization.rule: no result may attribute a gain to CSA if HCA, raw local coverage, cache representation, or attention placement changes in the same cell

causal_and_state_semantics_required.high_resolution_entries: each entry names an immutable causal source span and becomes visible only after all contributing tokens are available
causal_and_state_semantics_required.selection_mask: future entries are excluded before scoring and top-k
causal_and_state_semantics_required.unfinished_tail: partial compressed spans and current selection blocks are represented separately and never leak future tokens
causal_and_state_semantics_required.selected_blocks: historical blocks are contiguous and shared across the query-head group for reusable K/V fetch
causal_and_state_semantics_required.current_block: if included, it uses an explicit causal mask rather than historical-block semantics
causal_and_state_semantics_required.softmax: selected historical/current contributions use one mathematically equivalent normalization, not separately normalized sums
causal_and_state_semantics_required.ties: top-k tie breaking is deterministic and pinned
causal_and_state_semantics_required.prefix_reuse: index keys, compressed entries, block identities, and tails have exact cache-hit/recompute rules
causal_and_state_semantics_required.eviction_resume: selection indices and all state identities survive checkpoint, eviction, and resume
causal_and_state_semantics_required.decode_modes: sparse prefill/sparse decode is primary; sparse prefill/full decode and full/full are separately labeled controls

selector_feasibility_sequence.input: frozen dense-attention probabilities aggregated into candidate causal source blocks
selector_feasibility_sequence.selection: top blocks by true dense-attention mass under each frozen budget
selector_feasibility_sequence.purpose: upper-bound whether the block granularity and budget can retain the required evidence
selector_feasibility_sequence.failure: stop; do not train a learned selector at that granularity/budget

selector_feasibility_sequence.input: query dot mean key per causal block
selector_feasibility_sequence.selection: same granularity, budget, deterministic ties, and head sharing as the oracle
selector_feasibility_sequence.failure: does not authorize token-level selection; compare the learned block indexer next if the oracle passed

selector_feasibility_sequence.input: compact query/index-key scores with inputs and precision frozen before training
selector_feasibility_sequence.target: L1-normalized dense block-mass distribution with a separately reported selected-set objective
selector_feasibility_sequence.gradient: selector objective and language-model objective paths are reported separately; detachment is an experimental choice, not silently assumed
selector_feasibility_sequence.purpose: test whether learned block routing closes the oracle gap

conditional_geometry_grid.budget_rule: attend to min(history, budget) raw-token-equivalent capacity; report actual unique causal source tokens and compressed entries
conditional_geometry_grid.screening_rule: mechanism-scale oracle screening eliminates infeasible cells before any learned selector; freeze the smallest passing block and budget frontier on held-out cases
conditional_geometry_grid.token_level_escape_hatch: requires a successor contract proving block-level oracle or learned recall fails while a token-level oracle passes at a realizable kernel budget

selector_metrics.dense_mass_recall: fraction of dense-attention probability mass contained in selected causal blocks
selector_metrics.critical_source_recall: fraction of every declared route, payload, and distractor source span included by selection
selector_metrics.all_required_sources: example passes only when every required constituent source is selected
ranking: margin between last required and first excluded distractor block
calibration: KL divergence to normalized dense block mass
captured mass by layer, head group, query position, distance, and load
selector_metrics.rule: index overlap alone is never sufficient because dense blocks carry unequal probability and causal importance

quality_endpoints: structured retrieval candidate accuracy, specificity, and retention
symbolic route, payload, and direct composition with all-required-source recall
independent long-context suites only after their existing gates qualify
full/full, sparse/sparse, and sparse-prefill/full-decode outputs reported separately

complexity_and_state_accounting.dense_index_scan: O(L^2/m) when every query scores every L/m compressed index entry; a lower coefficient is not linear complexity
complexity_and_state_accounting.selected_attention: O(Lk) in selected compressed entries or raw-token-equivalent budget
complexity_and_state_accounting.coarse_hca: retain the separately measured dense-summary O(L^2/m') term
state: HCA and KDA state reported separately

training_sequence_if_qualified: train or select a matched dense teacher under a separately frozen contract
qualify oracle block granularity and budgets on held-out mechanism cases
train the indexer only against frozen dense targets and report selector metrics
freeze one selector/budget before joint sparse continuation
run matched sparse and dense continuation with identical tokens/data/optimizer
from-scratch architecture claims require their own matched from-scratch replication; converted checkpoints alone cannot promote CSA

systems_gate.rule: selector recall, analytic sparsity, or a prefill-only kernel cannot substitute for end-to-end sparse-prefill/sparse-decode improvement

decision.next_action: after parent and HCA selection, execute only the frozen oracle block-mass feasibility matrix
